name: Birthday Block
description: A block and a page that display users whose birthdays are today or in the coming week.
project_description: Birthday Block provides a block plugin ('birthday_block') and a page ('/user/birthday') that list users whose birthday falls today or within the next week. On install it creates two required user fields, 'field_dob' (Date of Birth, datetime date) and 'field_first_name' (First Name, string), which must be enabled on the user 'Manage form display'; both fields are removed on uninstall. The block shows today's birthdays plus up to two upcoming ones with a 'View All' link to the page. Depends only on core User.
